entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State where no procedure transaction is active in the UE.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State where the UE has initiated a procedure transaction towards the network and is awaiting response.

entities.name: UE initiated 5GSM procedure request
entities.description: Condition where the UE initiates a 5GSM procedure request.

entities.name: UE initiated 5GSM procedure reject by network
entities.description: Condition where the network rejects a UE-initiated 5GSM procedure.

entities.name: Network initiated 5GSM procedure
entities.description: Condition where the network initiates a 5GSM procedure.

relations.description: Transition from PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING when UE initiates a 5GSM procedure request.
Condition guards the transition to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
Transition from PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE when UE-initiated procedure is rejected by network or network initiates a procedure.
Condition guards the transition back to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
Condition guards the transition back to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
